info.title: Cinema Hall Ticket Booking API
info.description: Customer, staff and admin APIs. Log in through POST /api/auth/login and paste the returned token into Authorize. Errors always use the ErrorResponse shape, with a stable `code` such as SEATS_UNAVAILABLE or HOLD_EXPIRED.

post.summary: Hold seats. All are claimed or none; 409 SEATS_UNAVAILABLE if any is taken.

post.description: Send a unique Idempotency-Key per attempt. Repeating a key returns the original booking with status 200 instead of creating a second one.

get.summary: The caller's live hold for a show, or 204 if there is none
